description: Terminal precision: each scenario is N identical steps run through each library in its native representation, against the same loop in exact arithmetic (mpmath, 200 digits). digits = correct leading significant digits (60 = bit-identical to the rounded truth, i.e. exact); gas = per step, measured through LadderRunner and including the amortised call overhead.

compound.title: Daily compound interest
compound.why: Per-block or per-day accrual in every lending protocol: one mul per step, N steps.

compound-pow.title: Compound interest in one pow
compound-pow.result: the same balance, computed with one real-exponent pow
compound-pow.why: The clever way to skip the loop. pow is exp(N ln(1+r)) in every library, so its precision is bounded by ln and exp, and the error grows with N without any loop.

bonding-sqrt.title: Square-root bonding curve
bonding-sqrt.result: total cost of N unit buys
bonding-sqrt.why: Bonding curves price each token at a root of the supply; the sum of N floors is where the digits go.

roundtrip.title: exp(ln(x)) round trip
roundtrip.result: x after N round trips; the answer is the input
roundtrip.why: Isolates transcendental error. Every step should be the identity; what remains is the library's ln and exp error, compounded.

amortise.title: Amortising loan
amortise.result: outstanding balance after N daily payments
amortise.why: Subtracting nearly equal numbers. The payment retires the loan at step 366, so at N = 365 the balance is one payment and relative error is amplified several hundred times.

geo-mean.title: Running geometric mean
geo-mean.step: L += ln(x_i); g = exp(L / N), x_i = (i + 2) / (i + 1)
geo-mean.result: geometric mean of N terms; truth telescopes to ((N + 2) / 2)^(1 / N)
geo-mean.why: Index and basket maths: a sum of logs, one division, one exp. The division by N and the final exp expose every accumulated ULP.

black-scholes-chain.title: Black-Scholes d1 along a price path
black-scholes-chain.step: acc += d1(S); S += tick, with d1 = (ln(S / K) + (r + sigma^2 / 2) T) / (sigma sqrt(T))
black-scholes-chain.result: sum of d1 over N ticks
black-scholes-chain.why: The options-desk case: ln, div, sqrt and mul in one expression, re-evaluated as the spot moves and aggregated.

cumulative-product.title: Cumulative product of small factors
cumulative-product.step: p = p * (1 + eps_i), eps_i = +eps for odd i, -eps for even i
cumulative-product.why: The general form of fee accrual, index levels and LP share accounting: many factors a basis point from one. The drift from 1 is where the digits are, and it is small.

compound-annual.title: Annual compounding at 10% (README claim check)
compound-annual.why: The old README asserted $25,937.42 true against $25,932.38 for Solady at N = 10 with no source. This row regenerates that number.
